::: {#exr-three-optimizers}

#### Plain steps, momentum and Adam

Train three fresh [MLP](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-feedforward-network)s for 5 [epoch](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-epoch)s on minibatches of 32, using `train()` from @sol-minibatch-epochs:
one with `torch.optim.SGD` at [learning rate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-learning-rate) 0.1,
one with `torch.optim.SGD` at learning rate 0.01 and momentum 0.9,
and one with `torch.optim.Adam`, PyTorch's [Adam](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-adam), at learning rate 0.01.
Which reaches the lowest training loss?

:::
